description:
Cast Kodama of the East Tree either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {4}{G}{G} plus commander tax, if applicable.
Holding priority, cast Double Major by paying {G}{U}, copying the Kodama of the East Tree spell, with the copy not being legendary.
Resolve both Kodama of the East Tree spells.
Play Oboro, Palace in the Clouds.
Both Kodama of the East Trees trigger.
In response, activate Oboro's first ability by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Oboro's last ability by paying {1}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the token Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the nontoken Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Oboro, Palace in the Clouds from your hand onto the battlefield.
The token Kodama of the East Tree triggers.
In response, activate Oboro's first ability by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Oboro's last ability by paying {1}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the token Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Oboro, Palace in the Clouds from your hand onto the battlefield.
The nontoken Kodama of the East Tree triggers.
Repeat from step 6.
